description: Wave 6D-8 strictly read-only console probes (53 probes across 4 batches) covering AI packages, script/interrupt packages, package list/field mutations, AI state flags, followers/teammates, companion wheel flags, multi-target combat/flee/yield, faction reactions and multi-faction precedence, karma alignment/titles/kill GMSTs, reputation clamps/invalid axes, ownership/trespassing/crime alarms, detection overrides, and pickpocket/stealth flags.
